messages:
kate-sales: Heads-up  Prospect CedarBridge is blocked on staging until procurement gets SOC 2 artifacts, an ISO certificate, and a signed pen-test attestation with a named signer. Can we turn those around today?

eric-se: I can pull the SOC2 summary + control mapping excerpt now. We'll redact org/user names. Does procurement need the full report or just the bridge?

nora-security: For POCs we provide the SOC2 Type II summary and a redacted control matrix. Full SOC2 report requires NDA + secure transfer. We can share the ISO cert PDF no problem.

liam-ps: Procurement wants a pen-test attestation on letterhead with a named signatory for their vendor check. Who can sign and how fast?

nora-security: I can sign as Director of Security today. Standard attestation: "Redwood Inference attests a third-party penetration test was performed on YYYY-MM and no critical open findings remained at report time." We don't share raw findings without contract terms.

upload-bot: action: created presigned S3 upload link (expires 7 days)  DM'd to kate-sales (link hidden).

kate-sales: CedarBridge also needs EU residency for the POC (eu-west-1). For short trials we can host in eu-west-1 with isolation but it impacts pricing. Can someone estimate delta?

eric-se: Short POC in eu-west-1 on Hosted + VPC isolation is doable. Quick estimate: ~1.6x baseline for a 2-week reserved slice. If they require customer-managed KMS we need Dedicated/Private and ~72h lead time.

liam-ps: I'll draft a small pilot pricing matrix and pilot credit options tomorrow to unblock procurement.

kate-sales: Plan: 1) nora upload signed pen-test attestation to presigned link TODAY, 2) devex upload SOC2 summary + ISO cert TODAY, 3) eric send eu pricing delta + KMS lead time TOMORROW, 4) liam propose pilot credit terms TOMORROW.

nora-security: Will upload attestation and include signer contact info.

devex: Presigned link DM'd to kate. Upload queued; reminder: do not paste presigned links in channel :lock:

kate-sales: Thanks team  I'll update CedarBridge and request procurement to accept Director-level attestation if possible. :thumbsup:
